availableOptionsText.title: Available Options Text
availableOptionsText.description: Plain-text size/color combinations of this product currently in stock, when the requested one is not available

currentSkuPrice.title: Current SKU Price
currentSkuPrice.description: Price of the SKU currently owned, when known

isAvailable.title: Is Available
isAvailable.description: Whether the requested size/color is currently in stock

newSkuPrice.title: New SKU Price
newSkuPrice.description: Price of the resolved SKU, when known

priceDifference.title: Price Difference
priceDifference.description: New SKU price minus current SKU price. Positive = customer owes the difference, negative = refund owed, zero or blank = no additional charge.

resolvedSkuId.title: Resolved SKU Id
resolvedSkuId.description: Id of the SKU matching product+size+color, when available

resolvedSkuName.title: Resolved SKU Name
resolvedSkuName.description: Name of the resolved SKU, e.g. Denim Jacket - Navy - L
